ex.en: I sliced a zucchini and fried it with garlic.
ex.zh: 我把一條櫛瓜切片，和大蒜一起炒。

ex.en: She grows zucchini and tomatoes in her garden.
ex.zh: 她在花園裡種櫛瓜和番茄。

ex.en: Zurich is the largest city in Switzerland.
ex.zh: 蘇黎世是瑞士最大的城市。

ex.en: Many trains run between Zurich and Geneva every day.
ex.zh: 每天有許多列車往返蘇黎世和日內瓦。

ex.en: Zulu is one of the official languages of South Africa.
ex.zh: 祖魯語是南非的官方語言之一。

ex.en: Many Zulu live in the KwaZulu-Natal region of South Africa.
ex.zh: 許多祖魯人住在南非的誇祖魯－納塔爾地區。
